name: Binary vector pCAMBIA-1300
boundary_convention: Constructed adjacency at the outside end of the annotated border interval; not a claim about a biological nick position. The T-DNA-containing segment crosses the circular sequence origin.
primary_design: 20 retained reference positions/profile, alternate RB and LB at successive positions, two read orientations, 40 reads/profile. These are separate test reads, not paired flanks of one integration.
interpretation: Known-vector-sequence synthetic junction tests, not observed transformation events or independent biological junction validation.
